About ZIVWA

Connecting technology, talent and learning to create practical opportunities for progress.

Many capabilities.
One shared purpose.

ZIVWA Global Solutions Pvt Ltd is a Bengaluru-based company working across technology solutions, recruitment and staffing, training and placement activities, and skill development.

Our work connects the needs of businesses with the capabilities of people. Whether you are building a digital product, strengthening your workforce or preparing for a career, we begin by understanding your goal.

We also welcome industry–academia partnerships that bring practical learning and professional readiness closer together.

Our mission

To support businesses and individuals through practical technology, relevant talent and purposeful skill development.

Our vision

To build a connected ecosystem where industry needs, learning and opportunity move forward together.

every partnership.
